occurrences.text: Give unto the Lord the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come before him: worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness.

And when he had consulted with the people, he appointed singers unto the Lord, and that should praise the beauty of holiness, as they went out before the army, and to say, Praise the Lord; for his mercy endureth for ever.
Give unto the Lord the glory due unto his name; worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness.
O worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness: fear before him, all the earth.
In the multitude of people is the king’s honour: but in the want of people is the destruction of the prince.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
